Louis H. Sullivan, The Autobiography of an Idea.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/louis-h-sullivan/the-autobiography-of-an-idea

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Louis H. Sullivan, the author, died 1924.

First publication of the text used: 1922 (SE colophon: 'The Autobiography of an Idea was published in 1922 by Louis H. Sullivan.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1922, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2017.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication): the last person to die did so in 1924. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, from 1 January 2025.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
